overview_description.description: Funding Souq is a digital lending platform that aims to address the $230bn SME funding gap across the MENA region. The platform connects creditworthy borrowers to lenders who will have the opportunity to generate a competitive return by lending to local businesses by adhering to the principles of Islamic Finance.

about_short_description.short_description: Funding Souq is an online lending platform that connects investors with established SMEs that are seeking business loans.

product.name: Funding Souq Debt Crowdfunding Marketplace
product.description: An online marketplace that connects established SMEs seeking financing with individual and institutional investors who fund business opportunities through debt-based crowdfunding.

product.name: SME Business Financing
product.description: A Sharia-compliant business financing service for established SMEs, providing access to capital through an online application and investor-funded financing process.

product.name: Private Credit Investing
product.description: An investment service that gives retail and institutional investors access to short-term, Sharia-compliant private credit opportunities backed by SME financing transactions.
